reason: Type/application gap: lem-compcb-amplification-naturality applies to the isometric diagonal embedding iota_n:B(A)->M_n(B(A)), X↦1_{M_n}⊗X. The desired T_{P_n,Q_n}=I_n⊗T_{P,Q}, however, is an operator on M_n⊗A, i.e. the entrywise map B(A)->B(M_n⊗A). The node neither identifies M_n(B(A)) with the relevant operator algebra nor proves that the canonical action/entrywise-amplification homomorphism preserves the theta power series. In general amplification of a merely bounded operator on an operator space is governed by matrix/cb norms and is not automatically the isometric homomorphism assumed by the cited lemma. Thus the cited lemma does not, as stated, yield theta(T_{P_n,Q_n})=I_n⊗theta(T_{P,Q}); an additional naturality argument for the actual homomorphism (using separately established convergence at both levels) is required.
